content: While we have focused specifically on the task of forecasting derailment, we view this work as a step towards a more general model for real-time forecasting of other types of emergent properties of conversations. Follow-up work could adapt the CRAFT architecture to address other forecasting tasks mentioned in Section SECREF2—including those for which the outcome is extraneous to the conversation. We expect different tasks to be informed by different types of inter-comment dynamics, and further architecture extensions could add additional supervised fine-tuning in order to direct it to focus on specific dynamics that might be relevant to the task (e.g., exchange of ideas between interlocutors or stonewalling).
